definitions.gloss: from time to time, occasionally, at times
definitions.explanation: At irregular intervals, now and then. Slightly more literary than ときどき.

examples.japanese: {折々|おりおり}{思|おも}い{出|だ}す。
examples.english: I recall it from time to time.

examples.japanese: {季節|きせつ}{折々|おりおり}の{花|はな}を{楽|たの}しむ。
examples.english: To enjoy the flowers of each season.

examples.japanese: {折々|おりおり}に{触|ふ}れて、{先生|せんせい}の{言葉|ことば}が{心|こころ}に{浮|う}かぶ。
examples.english: From time to time, my teacher's words come to mind.

notes:
USAGE:
{折々|おりおり} is a somewhat literary or refined expression compared to the more colloquial ときどき. It is often used in writing and formal speech. The expression {季節|きせつ}{折々|おりおり} ("of each season") and {折々|おりおり}に{触|ふ}れて ("on various occasions") are set phrases.

Also written as {折|おり}{折|おり} or おりおり.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {折々|おりおり}に{触|ふ}れて: on various occasions, whenever the opportunity arises
- {季節|きせつ}{折々|おりおり}: of each season, seasonal
- {四季|しき}{折々|おりおり}: of each of the four seasons
